from verify import VERIFY_SECONDS, confirm_decision, verify_board, wording_check

try:  # the pipeline degrades without them
    import research_tender
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    research_tender = None
try:
    import research_mail
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    research_mail = None
try:
    import mail_batch
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    mail_batch = None

# research ends this long before the end: the form needs up to ~185 s and signing ~30 s (173 s with a bad TAN)
SUBMIT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_SUBMIT_SECONDS", "390"))
FORM_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_FORM_SECONDS", "300"))  # the bid form and signing need this much
# Mail tabs in the webmail's one browser: about nine record kinds took three rounds over four tabs, and the mail is the
# last research to finish; six tabs take them in two rounds (tabs are free, the work and its cost stay the same).
MAIL_TABS = int(os.environ.get("MAIL_TABS", "6"))
SPEC_STEPS_FAST = int(os.environ.get("SPEC_STEPS_FAST", "25"))  # navigation steps of the fast spec attempt
SPEC_STEPS_THINKING = int(os.environ.get("SPEC_STEPS_THINKING", "35"))  # and of the careful one, run alongside
SELECT_SECONDS = 75.0  # the final material choice (a model call per requirement, in parallel)
DEFERRED_SECONDS = 90.0  # reading deferred ERP hits before the final choice (rare: an amendment moved the match)
KIND_OPTIONS = set(inspect.signature(research_mail.research_kind).parameters) if research_mail else set()
KIND_MIN_SECONDS = 120.0  # a mail record kind's search budget: at least this
KIND_MAX_SECONDS = 240.0  # and at most this, from the mail time left per kind
MAIL_RETRY_SECONDS = 90.0  # mail time a kind's second try needs
MAIL_TAB_STAGGER = 4.0  # seconds between the mail tabs' sign-ins
MAIL_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAIL_SECONDS", "540"))  # from the orchestrator's start
# How long the mail planner waits for the tender's keys before planning from the brief alone. The keys arrive with
# the Q&A (about 120 s in) while the wait was 45 s, so every sandbox run planned from the brief alone after waiting:
# the wait only held the mail searches, the last research to finish, back by 45 s. Positions already on the
# board are still passed along.
FINDINGS_WAIT = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_FINDINGS_WAIT", "0"))
PLAN_PATIENT_TIMEOUT = 90.0  # per call when the quick mail plan failed: a loaded model answers in up to ~90 s
# doubtful mail facts go back to their search in the gap pass's first round (side by side with the gap retries)
# instead of in a round of their own before calc, which held the first answer back by up to 2 minutes
GAP_REWORK = os.environ.get("AGENT_GAP_REWORK", "1") == "1"
VERIFY_ALONGSIDE = os.environ.get("AGENT_VERIFY_ALONGSIDE", "1") == "1"  # see run()
REWORK_SECONDS = 150.0
TENDER_WATCH_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_TENDER_WATCH_SECONDS", "240"))  # no positions by then: retry
RECHECK_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_RECHECK_SECONDS", "150"))  # the Q&A re-check before a no_bid
# A no_bid settled while the mail searches still run (see _early_no_bid) ends the searches that only price
# positions: a no_bid answer then waited for every mail kind (up to MAIL_SECONDS) and the gap rounds after it.
EARLY_NO_BID = os.environ.get("AGENT_EARLY_NO_BID", "1") == "1"
NO_BID_POLL = 5.0  # seconds between the research loop's checks for a settled no_bid
NO_BID_MAIL_WAIT = 120.0  # how long a settled no_bid waits for the discount approval's search to finish
NO_BID_KEEP = ("approval",)  # the mail kinds a no_bid answer still uses (rule 16: discount_percent)
TENDER_RETRY_SECONDS = 150.0  # research time a second tender attempt needs  # a doubtful fact goes back to its worker only with at least this much research time left


async def start_session(session: SiteSession, until: float | None = None) -> SiteSession:
    """Open and sign in (SiteSession.start: waits on a slow tab, retries with backoff until `until`)."""
    await session.start(until=until)
    return session

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the planner

FACT_KINDS = {
        assert self.erp is not None
        for research in self.erp.requirements:
            for problem in research.problems:
                self.board.problem("materials", f"{research.requirement_id}: {problem}")
            record = self.erp.materials.get(research.selected) if research.selected else None
            value = {"selected": research.selected, "inspected": research.inspected,
                     "search_term": research.search_term}
            quote = ""
            if record is not None:
                value.update({k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v) for k, v in record.model_dump(
                    mode="json", exclude={"raw", "conditions"}).items()})
                value["conditions"] = [c.model_dump(mode="json") for c in record.conditions]
                raw = record.raw or {}
                quote = f"status {raw.get('status_code', '')} {raw.get('status_meaning', '')}; stock {raw.get('free_stock', '')}"
            self.board.post("material", research.requirement_id, value, Source(site=site, quote=quote), "materials")

    async def mails(self, site: str) -> None:
        board = self.board
        self.mail_site = site
        try:
            # The tabs sign in while the planner reads the brief and waits for the tender's keys.
            # Staggered: several tabs signing in to one website at the same moment hung in local runs.
            starts = [asyncio.create_task(self._mail_tab(site, i)) for i in range(MAIL_TABS)]
            positions = (await board.wait("position", timeout=min(FINDINGS_WAIT, max(1.0, self.left())))
                         if FINDINGS_WAIT > 0 else board.get("position"))
            findings = "\n".join(f"- position {k}: " + ", ".join(
                f"{f} {v}" for f, v in fact.value.items() if f.endswith("_key") or f == "condition_group")
                for k, fact in positions.items())
            sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in self.task["access"]}
            try:
                kinds = await self._plan_mail(sites, findings)
            except BaseException:
                for start in starts:  # no plan, no searches: the tabs would only compete for the browser
                    start.cancel()
                raise
            self.mail_kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == site]
            elsewhere = [f"{k.name} on {k.site}" for k in kinds if k.site != site]
            if elsewhere:  # another mail site would be its own job (the plan names every website it needs)
                board.problem("mails", f"planned on other websites, not searched here: {elsewhere}")
            self.trace.event("mails", "plan", kinds=[f"{k.name}: {k.subject} / {k.sender}" for k in self.mail_kinds])
            if mail_batch is not None and mail_batch.MAIL_BATCH and self.mail_kinds:
                rest, starts = await self._batch_mail(self.mail_kinds, starts)
                await self._research_mail(rest, starts=starts)
            else:
                await self._research_mail(self.mail_kinds, starts=starts)
        except Exception as error:
            board.problem("mails", f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
        finally:
            board.finish("mail")

    async def _plan_mail(self, sites: dict[str, str], findings: str) -> list:
        """
        The mail plan, with a patient second try: under platform load (model p50 11 s, p95 91 s in one soak run)
        every attempt of the short-timeout plan call timed out, and without a plan no mail kind was searched at all
        (discount, surcharges, packaging and bonus lost).
        """
        # (timeout per call, budget for all its retries): the quick try gets about two attempts, not seven
        tries = ((research_mail.PLAN_TIMEOUT, 2.5 * research_mail.PLAN_TIMEOUT), (PLAN_PATIENT_TIMEOUT, None))
        timeouts = [t for t, _ in tries]
        for i, (timeout, budget) in enumerate(tries):
            left = self.mail_deadline - time.monotonic()
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    research_mail.plan_searches(self.task["brief"], sites, findings, timeout=timeout),
                    max(1.0, min(left, budget or left)))
            except Exception as error:
                if i == len(timeouts) - 1 or self.mail_deadline - time.monotonic() < 2 * PLAN_PATIENT_TIMEOUT:
                    raise
                self.board.problem("mails", f"plan failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}); "
                                            f"planning again with {PLAN_PATIENT_TIMEOUT:g} s per call")
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")

    async def _batch_mail(self, kinds: list, starts: list) -> tuple[list, list]:
        """
        The batched mail research (mail_batch): the model's queries in every folder, one selection, one reader per
        kind. Returns the kinds left to the per-kind workers and the tabs for them (open ones and still starting).
        """
        def joined(session: SiteSession) -> None:
            if session not in self.mail_sessions:
                self.mail_sessions.append(session)

        try:
            outcome = await mail_batch.research_batch(starts, kinds, self.reference, self.briefing.scenario_date,
                                                      deadline=self.mail_deadline, joined=joined,
                                                      brief=self.task["brief"])
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"batch: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}; per-kind search")
            outcome = None
        if outcome is not None:
            self.mail_results.update(outcome.results)
            if outcome.reasons:
                self.trace.event("mails", "batch_fallback", kinds=outcome.reasons)
            rest = outcome.fallback
            self.mail_optional = set(outcome.optional)
        else:
            rest = list(kinds)
        open_ = {id(s) for s in self.mail_sessions}
        def joined_already(t) -> bool:
            return t.done() and not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is None and id(t.result()) in open_

        tabs = [*self.mail_sessions, *[t for t in starts if not joined_already(t)]]
        return rest, tabs

    # a mail record kind -> the tender position field (from the Q&A) whose key it resolves (gaps.MAIL_KEYS)
    MAIL_KEY_FIELDS = {"condition_rules": "condition_group", "packaging": "packaging_key",
                       "commitments": "commitment_key", "setup_pools": "setup_pool_key", "project_bonus": "bonus_key"}
    NEEDS_WAIT = 150.0  # how long a kind that found nothing waits for the tender's keys before its own search

    async def _mail_needed(self, kind) -> bool:
        """
        Whether the bid needs a record kind whose searches found nothing: the approval always; a kind keyed by the
        Q&A only if a tender position names such a key (waited for, up to NEEDS_WAIT); the rest (stroke reserves,
        metal indices, FX, which the specification and the ERP decide) always. A kind left out here is still
        searched by the gap pass when a key stays unresolved.
        """
        attr = self.MAIL_KEY_FIELDS.get(kind.name)
        if attr is None:
            return True
        until = time.monotonic() + min(self.NEEDS_WAIT, max(0.0, self.mail_deadline - time.monotonic() - 180))
        while self.tender_facts is None and time.monotonic() < until:
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
        if self.tender_facts is None:
            return True
        return any(getattr(p, attr, None) for p in getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", []))

    async def plan_missing(self, names: list[str]) -> list:
        """
        Record kinds the mail plan left out but the run still needs (the gap pass found no approval, or a key the
        Q&A names): the model plans again, told which kinds are missing; the new kinds join `mail_kinds`.
        """
        site = getattr(self, "mail_site", "") or (self.mail_sessions[0].name.split(":")[0] if self.mail_sessions
                                                    else "")
        sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in self.task["access"]}
        note = (f"The first plan left out these record kinds, which the bid still needs: {', '.join(names)}. "
                f"Plan them with their subject and sender as the brief states them.")
        kinds = await asyncio.wait_for(
            research_mail.plan_searches(self.task["brief"], sites, note, timeout=PLAN_PATIENT_TIMEOUT),

A website of the run read over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): sign-in, pages as text, forms, paging.

The websites render on the server, so a GET returns what a tab would show (http_read.html_view turns it into text)
in about 0.1 to 0.3 s. The sandbox reaches the websites only through HTTP(S)_PROXY; httpx honours it (trust_env).

Generic helpers only, as in the browser path: signing in with the run's credentials, accepting the minimal cookie
choice, retrying a flaky error page, signing in again when the session ends, putting same-site frames in place and
following a list's next-page links when a model asked for that list. Which pages are read, which searches are made
and which forms are sent (e.g. an entry check that asks for a number shown on the page) is the model's choice
(http_nav.py).
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse, parse_qsl

import httpx2

from http_read import Form, html_view

USER_AGENT = "error404ai-rfq-agent/2 (+http)"
FETCH_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("HTTP_FETCH_SECONDS", "12"))  # one request; a stalled one is tried again
TRIES = 3  # an error page or a stalled request is tried this often
FRAME_DEPTH = 2
MAX_PAGES = 25  # list pages followed per collect()
PARALLEL = int(os.environ.get("HTTP_PARALLEL", "8"))  # requests at once per website

ERROR_PAGE = re.compile(r"vorübergehend nicht verfügbar|temporarily unavailable|service unavailable|bad gateway|"
                        r"gateway time-?out|internal server error|bitte versuchen sie es (später )?erneut",
                        re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE = re.compile(r"cookie", re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_MINIMAL = re.compile(r"notwendig|erforderlich|necessary|essential|nur technisch|ablehnen|reject|decline",
                            re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_ANSWER = re.compile(r"akzeptier|accept|zustimm|agree|erlaub|allow|bestätig|confirm|ok\b", re.IGNORECASE)
LOGOUT = re.compile(r"log-?out|sign-?out|log off|abmeld", re.IGNORECASE)
NEXT = re.compile(r"^\s*(weiter|mehr|nächste|naechste|next|more|load more|show more|weitere|folgende|vorwärts|"
                  r"vorwaerts|›|»|>|→)", re.IGNORECASE)
NOT_NEXT = re.compile(r"zurück|zurueck|vorherige|previous|prev|back|erste|first|letzte|last", re.IGNORECASE)
LINK = re.compile(r'\[link "([^"]*)" -> (\S+?)\]')
TARGET_BUTTON = re.compile(r'\[button "([^"]*)"[^\]]*? -> (\S+?)\]')
FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame (\S+?)\]")


@dataclass
class Page:
    url: str  # where the request ended
    title: str
    text: str  # the view, frames in place
    forms: list[Form] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: int = 200
    seconds: float = 0.0
    asked: str = ""  # the address requested

    def targets(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """(text, target) of every link, target-carrying button and frame on the page."""
        out = [(t, h) for t, h in LINK.findall(self.text)] + [(t, h) for t, h in TARGET_BUTTON.findall(self.text)]
        out += [("frame", h) for h in FRAME.findall(self.text)]
        return out

    def view(self) -> str:
        return f"URL: {self.url}\nTitle: {self.title}\n\n{self.text}"


def _same(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    pa, pb = urlparse(a), urlparse(b)
    return pa.path.rstrip("/") == pb.path.rstrip("/") and sorted(parse_qsl(pa.query)) == sorted(parse_qsl(pb.query))


class HttpSite:
    """One website: a cookie session of its own, the pages read so far, and what the readers may quote (seen)."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, trace, tag: str = ""):
        self.site, self.trace = site, trace
        self.name = site["siteId"] + (f":{tag}" if tag else "")
        self.base = site["url"].rstrip("/") + "/"
        self.host = urlparse(self.base).netloc
        self.client = httpx2.AsyncClient(follow_redirects=True, timeout=FETCH_SECONDS, trust_env=True,
                                         headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Accept": "text/html,*/*"})
        self.limit = asyncio.Semaphore(PARALLEL)
        self.pages: dict[str, Page] = {}  # by requested and by final address
        self.seen = ""  # every page text read, for grounding checks
        self.view = ""  # the latest page's text (what helpers written for tabs look at)
        self.logins = 0
        self.login_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.relogin_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.ok = False
        self.home: Page | None = None
        self.requests = 0
        self.request_seconds = 0.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ requests

    def url(self, target: str, base: str | None = None) -> str:
        return urljoin(base or self.base, target.strip())

    def on_site(self, url: str) -> bool:
        return urlparse(url).netloc == self.host

    async def _request(self, method: str, url: str, data=None):
        last = None
        for attempt in range(TRIES):
            began = time.monotonic()
            try:
                async with self.limit:
                    if method == "GET":
                        response = await self.client.get(url)
                    else:
                        response = await self.client.post(  # a list keeps repeated names (checkbox groups)
                            url, content=urlencode(data or []).encode(),
                            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
            except Exception as error:  # a stalled or refused request: once more
                last = error
                self.trace.event(self.name, "http_retry", url=url[:120], error=f"{type(error).__name__}")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3 * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            finally:
                self.requests += 1
                self.request_seconds += time.monotonic() - began
            flaky = response.status_code >= 500 or (len(response.text) < 30000 and ERROR_PAGE.search(response.text))
            if flaky and attempt + 1 < TRIES:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.4 * (attempt + 1))
                if method != "GET":  # a post that landed on an error page: read where it went instead
                    method, url, data = "GET", str(response.url), None
                continue
            return response
        raise ConnectionError(f"{method} {url} failed: {type(last).__name__ if last else 'error page'}")

    def _signin(self, page: Page) -> Form | None:
        for form in page.forms:
            if any(f.kind == "password" for f in form.fields):
                return form
        return None

    async def _page(self, response, asked: str, depth: int = 0) -> Page:
        final = str(response.url)
        if "html" not in response.headers.get("content-type", "html"):
            text = response.text[:60000]
            return Page(final, "", text, [], response.status_code, asked=asked)
        view = html_view(response.text)
        text = view.text
        if depth < FRAME_DEPTH and view.frames:
            subs = await asyncio.gather(*(self._frame(self.url(src, final), depth) for src in view.frames))
            for i, sub in enumerate(subs):
                text = text.replace(f"\x00FRAME{i}\x00", sub)
        text = re.sub(r"\x00FRAME\d+\x00", "", text)
        return Page(final, view.title, re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text), view.forms, response.status_code, asked=asked)

    async def _frame(self, url: str, depth: int) -> str:
        if not url.startswith("http") or not self.on_site(url):
            return "(separate)"
        cached = self.pages.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached.text
        try:
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url, depth + 1)
        except Exception as error:
            return f"(not read: {type(error).__name__})"
        return page.text

    def _keep(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        self.pages[page.asked or page.url] = page
        self.pages.setdefault(page.url, page)
        self.seen += "\n" + page.text
        self.view = page.text
        self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=page.text, http=True)
        return page

    async def get(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, fresh: bool = False) -> Page:
        """The page at a target (relative to `base` or the site), signed in again if the session ended."""
        url = self.url(target, base)
        if not fresh and url in self.pages:
            return self.pages[url]
        began = time.monotonic()
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("GET", url)
        page = await self._page(response, url)
        if self.ok and self._signin(page) is not None:
            # the session ended: sign in again (once, however many requests noticed it) and ask again
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url)
        page.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_get", url=url[len(self.base) - 1:][:140] if url.startswith(self.base) else url[:140],
                         landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80] if not _same(url, page.url) else "",
                         status=page.status, seconds=page.seconds, chars=len(page.text))
        return self._keep(page)

    async def submit(self, page: Page, number: int, values: dict[str, str], button: str = "") -> Page:
        """Send form `number` (1-based, as the page text numbers it) of `page` with the given field values."""
        form = page.forms[number - 1]
        data = form.data(values, button)
        action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
        began = time.monotonic()
        if form.method == "get":
            parsed = urlparse(action)
            url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=urlencode(data)))
            return await self.get(url, fresh=True)
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("POST", action, data=data)
        result = await self._page(response, action)
        if self.ok and self._signin(result) is not None:
            # the session had ended: signed in again, the model gets the page the site now shows (it may have to
            # send the form again from that page)
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", page.url)
            result = await self._page(response, page.url)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_post", url=action[len(self.base) - 1:][:120],
                         fields=[k for k, _ in data if k not in form.hidden], landed=result.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                         status=result.status, seconds=result.seconds)
        result.asked = result.url
        return self._keep(result)

    async def collect(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, limit: int = MAX_PAGES) -> list[Page]:
        """A list a model chose, and its further pages along the next-page links (or load-more targets)."""
        first = await self.get(target, base)
        pages, seen = [first], {first.url}
        while len(pages) < limit:
            nxt = next((h for t, h in pages[-1].targets() if NEXT.search(t) and not NOT_NEXT.search(t)
                        and self.url(h, pages[-1].url) not in seen and self.on_site(self.url(h, pages[-1].url))), None)
            if nxt is None:
                break
            page = await self.get(nxt, pages[-1].url)
            if page.url in seen or page.text == pages[-1].text:
                break  # past the end, a site repeats its last page
            seen.add(page.url)
            pages.append(page)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_collect", url=target[:120], pages=len(pages))
        return pages

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ signing in

    async def relogin(self, seen_logins: int) -> None:
        """Sign in again unless another request already did since `seen_logins` (parallel requests that all saw
        the sign-in page would otherwise sign in one after another, each ending the session of the one before)."""
        async with self.relogin_lock:
            if self.logins != seen_logins:
                return
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_session_ended")
            await self.sign_in()

    async def sign_in(self, page: Page | None = None) -> Page:
        """Sign in with the run's credentials through the site's own form, then accept the minimal cookie choice."""
        async with self.login_lock:
            if page is None or self._signin(page) is None:
                response = await self._request("GET", self.base)
                page = await self._page(response, self.base)
            form = self._signin(page)
            if form is not None:
                creds = self.site.get("credentials") or {}
                values = {}
                user = next((f for f in form.fields if f.kind in ("text", "email", "") and f.kind != "password"), None)
                for f in form.fields:
                    if f.kind == "password":
                        values[f.name] = creds.get("password", "")
                if user is not None:
                    values[user.name] = creds.get("username", "")
                action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
                response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data(values))
                page = await self._page(response, action)
                self.logins += 1
            page = await self._consent(page)
            self.ok = self._signin(page) is None
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_signed_in", ok=self.ok, landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                             logins=self.logins)
            page.asked = page.url
            self.home = self._keep(page)
            return page

    async def _consent(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        """A cookie notice whose form has nothing to fill: the minimal (necessary-only) choice, as in the browser."""
        for _ in range(2):
            if not COOKIE.search(page.text):
                return page
            choice = None
            for form in page.forms:
                visible = [f for f in form.fields if f.kind not in ("hidden",)]
                if visible or not form.buttons or LOGOUT.search(form.action):
                    continue
                minimal = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_MINIMAL.search(b[2])]
                answers = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_ANSWER.search(b[2]) and not LOGOUT.search(b[2])]
                if minimal or len(answers) == 1:
                    choice = (form, (minimal or answers)[0])
                    break
            if choice is None:
                return page
            form, button = choice
            action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
            response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data({}, button[2]))
            page = await self._page(response, action)
        return page

    async def start(self) -> Page:
        """Signed in, on the page the start address lands on."""
        page = await self.sign_in()
        return page

    async def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.client.aclose()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def cookies(self) -> list[dict]:
        """The session cookies in Playwright's format, to hand the sign-in to a browser context."""
        out = []
        for c in self.client.cookies.jar:
            out.append({"name": c.name, "value": c.value, "domain": c.domain or self.host, "path": c.path or "/",
                        "secure": bool(c.secure), "httpOnly": True, "sameSite": "Lax"})
        return out

            flaky = response.status_code >= 500 or (len(response.text) < 30000 and ERROR_PAGE.search(response.text))
            if flaky and attempt + 1 < TRIES:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.4 * (attempt + 1))
                if method != "GET":  # a post that landed on an error page: read where it went instead
                    method, url, data = "GET", str(response.url), None
                continue
            return response
        raise ConnectionError(f"{method} {url} failed: {type(last).__name__ if last else 'error page'}")

    def _signin(self, page: Page) -> Form | None:
        for form in page.forms:
            if any(f.kind == "password" for f in form.fields):
                return form
        return None

    async def _page(self, response, asked: str, depth: int = 0) -> Page:
        final = str(response.url)
        if "html" not in response.headers.get("content-type", "html"):
            text = response.text[:60000]
            return Page(final, "", text, [], response.status_code, asked=asked)
        view = html_view(response.text)
        text = view.text
        if depth < FRAME_DEPTH and view.frames:
            subs = await asyncio.gather(*(self._frame(self.url(src, final), depth) for src in view.frames))
            for i, sub in enumerate(subs):
                text = text.replace(f"\x00FRAME{i}\x00", sub)
        text = re.sub(r"\x00FRAME\d+\x00", "", text)
        return Page(final, view.title, re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text), view.forms, response.status_code, asked=asked)

    async def _frame(self, url: str, depth: int) -> str:
        if not url.startswith("http") or not self.on_site(url):
            return "(separate)"
        cached = self.pages.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached.text
        try:
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url, depth + 1)
        except Exception as error:
            return f"(not read: {type(error).__name__})"
        return page.text

    def _keep(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        self.pages[page.asked or page.url] = page
        self.pages.setdefault(page.url, page)
        self.seen += "\n" + page.text
        self.view = page.text
        self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=page.text, http=True)
        return page

    async def get(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, fresh: bool = False) -> Page:
        """The page at a target (relative to `base` or the site), signed in again if the session ended."""
        url = self.url(target, base)
        if not fresh and url in self.pages:
            return self.pages[url]
        began = time.monotonic()
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("GET", url)
        page = await self._page(response, url)
        if self.ok and self._signin(page) is not None:
            # the session ended: sign in again (once, however many requests noticed it) and ask again
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url)
        page.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_get", url=url[len(self.base) - 1:][:140] if url.startswith(self.base) else url[:140],
                         landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80] if not _same(url, page.url) else "",
                         status=page.status, seconds=page.seconds, chars=len(page.text))
        return self._keep(page)

    async def submit(self, page: Page, number: int, values: dict[str, str], button: str = "") -> Page:
        """Send form `number` (1-based, as the page text numbers it) of `page` with the given field values."""
        form = page.forms[number - 1]
        data = form.data(values, button)
        action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
        began = time.monotonic()
        if form.method == "get":
            parsed = urlparse(action)
            url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=urlencode(data)))
            return await self.get(url, fresh=True)
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("POST", action, data=data)
        result = await self._page(response, action)
        if self.ok and self._signin(result) is not None:
            # the session had ended: signed in again, the model gets the page the site now shows (it may have to
            # send the form again from that page)
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", page.url)
            result = await self._page(response, page.url)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_post", url=action[len(self.base) - 1:][:120],
                         fields=[k for k, _ in data if k not in form.hidden], landed=result.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                         status=result.status, seconds=result.seconds)
        result.asked = result.url
        return self._keep(result)

    async def collect(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, limit: int = MAX_PAGES) -> list[Page]:
        """A list a model chose, and its further pages along the next-page links (or load-more targets)."""
        first = await self.get(target, base)
        pages, seen = [first], {first.url}
        while len(pages) < limit:
            nxt = next((h for t, h in pages[-1].targets() if NEXT.search(t) and not NOT_NEXT.search(t)
                        and self.url(h, pages[-1].url) not in seen and self.on_site(self.url(h, pages[-1].url))), None)
            if nxt is None:
                break
            page = await self.get(nxt, pages[-1].url)
            if page.url in seen or page.text == pages[-1].text:
                break  # past the end, a site repeats its last page
            seen.add(page.url)
            pages.append(page)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_collect", url=target[:120], pages=len(pages))
        return pages

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ signing in

    async def relogin(self, seen_logins: int) -> None:
        """Sign in again unless another request already did since `seen_logins` (parallel requests that all saw
        the sign-in page would otherwise sign in one after another, each ending the session of the one before)."""
        async with self.relogin_lock:
            if self.logins != seen_logins:
                return
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_session_ended")
            await self.sign_in()

    async def sign_in(self, page: Page | None = None) -> Page:
        """Sign in with the run's credentials through the site's own form, then accept the minimal cookie choice."""
        async with self.login_lock:
            if page is None or self._signin(page) is None:
                response = await self._request("GET", self.base)
                page = await self._page(response, self.base)
            form = self._signin(page)
            if form is not None:
                creds = self.site.get("credentials") or {}
                values = {}
                user = next((f for f in form.fields if f.kind in ("text", "email", "") and f.kind != "password"), None)
                for f in form.fields:
                    if f.kind == "password":
                        values[f.name] = creds.get("password", "")
                if user is not None:
                    values[user.name] = creds.get("username", "")
                action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
                response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data(values))
                page = await self._page(response, action)
                self.logins += 1
            page = await self._consent(page)
            self.ok = self._signin(page) is None
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_signed_in", ok=self.ok, landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                             logins=self.logins)
            page.asked = page.url
            self.home = self._keep(page)
            return page

    async def _consent(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        """A cookie notice whose form has nothing to fill: the minimal (necessary-only) choice, as in the browser."""
        for _ in range(2):
            if not COOKIE.search(page.text):
                return page
            choice = None
            for form in page.forms:
                visible = [f for f in form.fields if f.kind not in ("hidden",)]
                if visible or not form.buttons or LOGOUT.search(form.action):
                    continue
                minimal = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_MINIMAL.search(b[2])]
                answers = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_ANSWER.search(b[2]) and not LOGOUT.search(b[2])]
                if minimal or len(answers) == 1:
                    choice = (form, (minimal or answers)[0])
                    break
            if choice is None:
                return page
            form, button = choice
            action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
            response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data({}, button[2]))
            page = await self._page(response, action)
        return page

    async def start(self) -> Page:
        """Signed in, on the page the start address lands on."""
        page = await self.sign_in()
        return page

    async def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.client.aclose()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def cookies(self) -> list[dict]:
        """The session cookies in Playwright's format, to hand the sign-in to a browser context."""
        out = []
        for c in self.client.cookies.jar:
            out.append({"name": c.name, "value": c.value, "domain": c.domain or self.host, "path": c.path or "/",
                        "secure": bool(c.secure), "httpOnly": True, "sameSite": "Lax"})
        return out

+ typing-inspection==0.4.4 + urllib3==2.8.0 httpx2 httpx2-2.13.1.dist-info requires-python = ">=3.12" # pinned, so the run step gets the versions the kit was tested with dependencies = [ "anthropic==1.13.0", "openai==3.28.0", "playwright==1.63.0", "pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,openai]==2.55.0", ] [tool.uv] """ Read pages a model chose over plain HTTP, with the cookies of the browser session that signed in (AGENT_HTTP_READ=1). The four websites render their pages on the server, so a GET with the session's cookies returns the same content a browser tab shows, in about 0.1 to 0.3 s instead of a page load, settle and walk (1 to 5 s, much more when a site is slow). Only reading happens here: the model still chooses every address (a link target it has seen on a page), and signing in, consent, entry gates, forms, the bid wizard and signing stay in the browser. `html_view` turns HTML into the same kind of text `extract.observe` gives, minus refs: hidden elements dropped (the `hidden` attribute, `aria-hidden`, inline and stylesheet `display:none` / `visibility:hidden`, closed dialogs), collapsed `
` shown, tooltips and image/canvas labels inlined, links as `[link "text" -> target]`, same-site iframes fetched and shown in place, zero-width characters stripped. A page that needs the browser comes back as None and the caller opens it in its tab as before: a redirect to another page (a sign-in, a consent or entry gate), an error status or error page after a retry, an empty body, or a request that times out. """
v2 research check: read the brief, then the specification worker and the ERP workers, and print their records.

Run from the repo root with the scouting logins and the models proxy:
    eval "$(atira scout --env)"; HEADLESS=1 uv run --project agent python dev/research_check.py \
        [--reserve KEY=MM ...] [--only ID ...]

Usable-travel reserves come from the Technikfreigabe mail (another worker); pass them with --reserve to see the final
selection, otherwise those strokes stay pending and the ERP stage inspects every hit that matches the rest.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "agent"))

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402

import browsers  # noqa: E402
import calc  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from briefing import read_brief  # noqa: E402
from browser_tools import SiteSession  # noqa: E402
from evidence import effective_requirement, parse_date  # noqa: E402
from research import Erp, research_sites, research_spec, reselect  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


def _drop_raw(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _drop_raw(v) for k, v in value.items() if k != "raw"}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_drop_raw(v) for v in value]
    return value


def dump(model) -> str:
    return json.dumps(_drop_raw(json.loads(model.model_dump_json())), ensure_ascii=False)


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--reserve", action="append", default=[], help="KEY=per-end reserve in mm")
    parser.add_argument("--only", action="append", default=[], help="only these requirement ids in the ERP stage")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    reserves = {k: Decimal(v) for k, v in (r.split("=", 1) for r in args.reserve)}

    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    trace = Trace()
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    deadline = t0 + 15 * 60
    context = task["brief"].split("## Rules")[0].strip()
    briefing, sites = await asyncio.gather(read_brief(task), research_sites(task))
    t_brief = time.monotonic() - t0
    print(f"\nbrief read in {t_brief:.1f}s: tender {briefing.tender_reference}, spec site {sites.spec_site}, "
          f"ERP site {sites.erp_site}", flush=True)

Run the eval here: build and start it on 127.0.0.1:8710… with the platform's environment and a local stand-in for its endpoints, which accepts the printed logins and scores each answer the app hands in against expected.json; --env prints the exports for your agent from another terminal
# err404-layout (private team eval)

Same RFQ task, rules and answer schema as the challenge, in a different shape, to test how the agent copes with the
private final dataset's "other software, layouts and data". All data is invented.

| Site | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `sourcing-hub` | Notices (with a look-alike `-B` lot), "Register to bid", bill of items, the bid form |
| `buyer-extranet` | Specification TS-4471 (Rev. A shown first, Rev. C current) AND the bidder clarifications (Q&A) |
| `ops-suite` | ERP in English: search (max 20 hits), per material General / Stock & lead times / Pricing tabs |
| `inbox` | Mail with Inbox and Archive, oldest first, six per page, AND search; signing codes arrive here |

What differs from public-1: English labels everywhere; Q&A on the buyer's site, not the tender site; sidebar
navigation; the bid form is a table of three lines per page with repeated labels ("Qty", "Unit price"), a series
(catalogue group) select, an ARIA combobox for the material, a radio group for lead time and the bid type, English
numbers ("1,234.56"); six positions; USD conditions with "1 EUR = x USD" fixings and a per-100 price unit; two setup
pools with different cent rules; a marginal project bonus; metal indices in EUR per tonne with monthly windows; a
quantity change plus a withdrawn one; a "Rev. C" scoped amendment and a decoy amendment to Rev. B; sets of 4 pcs (5 in
older revisions); a production lead time in working days; a conditional discount that just passes; a price condition
starting on the scenario date; usable stroke with a revision-specific end reserve.

- `world.js`: the data. `DERIVATION.md`: how `expected.json` follows from it. `derive.py`: recomputes it in Decimal.
- `atira eval dev . --port 8810` runs it locally; `atira eval deploy .` (private) uploads it.

# Rows of a list: a container's repeated children. `arg` is [element or null, path or null]: a ref's element climbs
# to the repeating container around it; a remembered path finds the container again after a page change; without
# either, the page's main list (most rows with links and text, outside navigation) is chosen. Each row's visible
# text (tooltips, image labels and titles included, hidden text excluded) and its links with their refs come back.
ROWS_JS = r"""
([start, path]) => {
  const ZW = /[​‌‍⁠﻿­]/g;
  const clean = s => (s || '').replace(ZW, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const NAV = 'nav,header,footer,[role=navigation],[role=menu],[role=menubar],[role=tablist],select,datalist';
                   r"\b(seite|page)\s+\d+\s+(von|of)\s+\d+\b", re.IGNORECASE)


def _hit_notes(text: str, rows: int) -> list[str]:
    """What the page says about the result set: its count and paging, and, when no rows show, that there are
    too many or no hits (a page with rows is not a refused search, whatever its help text says)."""
    notes = []
    said = [" ".join(m.group(0).split()) for m in COUNT.finditer(text)]
    if said:
        notes.append("the page says: " + "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(said)))
    if rows:
        return notes
    for pattern, kind in ((TOO_MANY, "the site says the search has too many hits"),
                          (NO_HITS, "the site says there are no hits")):
        m = pattern.search(text)
        if m:
            notes.append(f"{kind}: \"{' '.join(m.group(0).split())[:160]}\"")
    return notes


def _shows_query(session: SiteSession, query: str) -> bool:
    """Whether the result page shows the query (in its field, the address or the text): a search that a pop-up or a
    re-rendered form swallowed comes back with an empty field and the unfiltered page."""
    want = " ".join(query.split()).casefold()
    if not want:
        return True
    url = unquote_plus(session.page.url)
    return want in " ".join(session.view.split()).casefold() or want in url.casefold()


async def _submit(session: SiteSession, field_ref: str, query: str, submit_ref: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Type and send the query; the failure text of the action, or None."""
    async def typed(element):
        await element.fill(query, timeout=5000)
        if not submit_ref:
            await element.press("Enter")
    view = await session.act("fill", field_ref, typed)
    if view.startswith("No element") or view.startswith("fill "):
        return view
    if submit_ref:
        view = await session.act("click", submit_ref, _click)
        if view.startswith("No element") or view.startswith("click "):
            return view
    return None


def control_label(view: str, ref: str | None) -> str:
    """The label a view shows for the control `ref` ('' if none)."""
    if not ref:
        return ""
    found = re.search(r"\[" + re.escape(ref) + r' \w+ "((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', view)
    return found.group(1) if found else ""


async def run_search(session: SiteSession, field_ref: str, query: str, submit_ref: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Fill the search field, submit, and list every row of the result list that shows. A result page that does
    not show the query (a pop-up or re-rendered form swallowed it) is searched once more."""
    # where the search was made and with which controls, so the same search can be repeated for another query
    form = {"form_url": session.page.url, "field_label": control_label(session.view, field_ref),
            "submit_label": control_label(session.view, submit_ref)}
    failed = await _submit(session, field_ref, query, submit_ref)
    if failed:
        return failed
    reached = _shows_query(session, query)
    if not reached:
        await session.look()
        session.trace.event(session.name, "search_resent", query=query, url=session.page.url)
        if not await _submit(session, field_ref, query, submit_ref):
            reached = _shows_query(session, query)
    said = _page_text(session)
    listing = await paginate(session)
    notes = _hit_notes(said, len(listing.rows))
    no_hits = bool(NO_HITS.search(said))
    if listing.rows and no_hits and not any(r.links for r in listing.rows):
        # the site says there are no hits and the "list" found has no links: page chrome, not hits
        listing.rows = []
        notes = _hit_notes(said, 0)
    listing.notes = notes + listing.notes
    if not reached:
        listing.notes.append(f"the result page does not show {query!r}: the search may not have been sent; "
                             "search again")
    complete = reached and bool(listing.rows) and not listing.capped
    header = (f"Search for {query!r}: {len(listing.rows)} rows" + (f" over {listing.pages} pages" if listing.pages > 1
              else "") + f" ({listing.how}). URL: {session.page.url}")
    text = _format(listing, header)
    if complete:
        text += (f"\nThis is the complete result list: {len(listing.rows)} "
                 f"{'hit' if len(listing.rows) == 1 else 'hits'}, no further page.")
    # what each search showed, for the harness: an empty result counts only with the site's own no-hits notice;
    # `complete` (the list ended, the query reached the site) and `text` let it end a worker that has its list
    session.__dict__.setdefault("searches", []).append(
        {"query": query, "rows": len(listing.rows) if reached or any(r.links for r in listing.rows) else 0,
         "no_hits": reached and not listing.rows and no_hits,
         "complete": complete, "text": text, "at": time.monotonic(), "listing": listing,
         "too_many": not listing.rows and bool(TOO_MANY.search(said)), "reached": reached, **form})
    return text

"""
The mailbox over plain HTTP (AGENT_MAIL_HTTP, on by default) for the batched mail research (mail_batch).

The webmail renders on the server, so the mail batch needs no browser tab: http_site signs in with the run's
credentials through the site's own form (cookies, consent, retries, re-login), http_read turns each page into the
same kind of text a tab shows. A page request takes 0.1 to 0.3 s instead of a tab's load, settle and walk.

What stays with the model: one call reads the mailbox's start page and names the search field and the folders
(`setup`); the plan's model-chosen queries, the selection of rows and the reading are mail_batch's as before.
Helpers here only send the model's query through the form the model named, page through its result list (next-page
links) and fetch the messages the model picked. Anything that does not work over HTTP (no sign-in, no form, a
redirect) returns None or an error, and mail_batch falls back to the browser tabs.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from urllib.parse import unquote_plus, urljoin, urlparse

from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry

import llm
import site_tools
from http_site import LINK, NEXT, HttpSite, Page

MAIL_HTTP = os.environ.get("AGENT_MAIL_HTTP", "1") == "1"
START_SECONDS = 30.0  # signing in (about 2 s)
SETUP_TIMEOUT = 30.0  # the setup call (thinking off) answers in a few seconds
MAX_PAGES = 12  # result pages followed per search (20 hits at most, three or more per page)
VIEW_CHARS = 14000  # of the start page shown to the setup call
FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame [^\]]*\].*?\[/frame\]", re.DOTALL)
CONTROL = re.compile(r"\[(?:button|textbox|checkbox|radio|slider|select|textarea|img)[^\]]*\]")
STOP = re.compile(site_tools.STOP_WORDS, re.IGNORECASE)
_TEXTBOX = re.compile(r'\[textbox "((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"')


def _words(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {w for w in re.split(r"[^\w]+", text.casefold()) if w}


def strip_frames(text: str) -> str:
    return FRAME.sub(" ", text)


def find_field(page: Page, label: str) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
    """(form number, field name) of the text field the model named: exactly its label, else the one field that
    shares the most words with it (a field labelled after its folder, e.g. "Search in <folder>")."""
    fields = [(n, f) for n, form in enumerate(page.forms, 1) for f in form.fields
              if f.kind in ("text", "search", "") and f.name]
    exact = [(n, f.name) for n, f in fields if f.label.strip() == label.strip()]
    if exact:
        return exact[0]
    want = _words(label)
    scored = sorted(((len(want & _words(f.label)), n, f.name) for n, f in fields), reverse=True)
    if scored and scored[0][0] > 0 and (len(scored) == 1 or scored[1][0] < scored[0][0]):
        return scored[0][1], scored[0][2]
    return None


def result_rows(text: str, skip: set[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """
    (subject, link target, row text) per line of a result page that carries a link plus some text of its own
    (a table row or list entry: subject, sender, date). Reading panes (frames), navigation and paging links and the
    `skip` targets (the folder links) are not rows.
    """
    out = []
    for line in strip_frames(text).splitlines():
        links = [(t, h) for t, h in LINK.findall(line)
                 if t.strip() and h not in skip and not NEXT.search(t) and not STOP.search(t)]
        if not links:
            continue
        rest = CONTROL.sub(" ", LINK.sub(" ", line))
        if not re.search(r"\w", rest):
            continue
        subject, href = links[0]
        shown = " ".join(CONTROL.sub(" ", LINK.sub(lambda m: m.group(1), line)).split())
        out.append((" ".join(subject.split()), href, shown))
    return out


def _next_target(page: Page, seen: set[str], site: HttpSite) -> str | None:
    for t, h in page.targets():
        if NEXT.search(t) and not STOP.search(t):
            url = site.url(h, page.url)
            if url not in seen and site.on_site(url):
                return url
    return None


class MailHttp:
    """The webmail over HTTP: one cookie session, the model's search setup, searches and message pages."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, trace):
        self.http = HttpSite(site, trace, "http")
        self.trace = trace
        self.home: Page | None = None
        self.field_label = ""
        self.folders: list = []  # mail_batch.FolderLink

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self.http.name

    @property
    def seen(self) -> str:
        return self.http.seen

    @property
    def view(self) -> str:
        return self.http.view

    @property
    def site(self) -> dict:
        return self.http.site

    async def start(self) -> bool:
        try:

def _thinking(request: httpx2.Request) -> str:
    content = request.content or b""
    markers = (b'"enable_thinking": true', b'"enable_thinking":true',  # Qwen
               b'"type": "adaptive"', b'"type":"adaptive"')  # Anthropic
    if any(marker in content for marker in markers):
        return "on"
    openrouter = b'"reasoning": {"effort"' in content or b'"reasoning":{"effort"' in content
    excluded = b'"exclude": true' in content or b'"exclude":true' in content
    return "on" if openrouter and not excluded else "off"


async def _sent(request: httpx2.Request) -> None:
    """Note when a call left; a retry (the OpenAI client counts them in a header) is logged, with the timeout the
    attempt runs under, so a hanging model shows in the run logs before the worker times out."""
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()
    attempt = int(request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0") or 0)
    if attempt:
        print(f"[model] retry {attempt}/{retries()} thinking {_thinking(request)} "
              f"timeout {request.headers.get('x-stainless-read-timeout', '?')}s", flush=True)


class _TimedBody(httpx2.AsyncByteStream):
    """A response body that logs the call once it has fully arrived: the proxy sends the headers early and a
    thinking-on body can follow much later, so logging at the headers would hide the real duration."""

    def __init__(self, response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
        self._response = response
        self._stream = response.stream

    @property
    def elapsed(self):
        return getattr(self._stream, "elapsed", None)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        complete = False
        try:
            async for chunk in self._stream:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                complete = complete or b"data: [DONE]" in chunk  # a stream's reader may stop right there
                yield chunk
            complete = True
        finally:
            _log(self._response, complete)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.aclose()  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def _log(response: httpx2.Response, complete: bool) -> None:
    """One line per model call: status, seconds until the body was in (and until the headers came), request
    size, thinking mode, and which retry it was."""
    request = response.request
    now = time.monotonic()
    sent, headers = request.extensions.get("sent_at", now), request.extensions.get("headers_at", now)
    attempt = request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0")
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {now - sent:.1f}s (headers {headers - sent:.1f}s) "
          f"{len(request.content or b'')} bytes thinking {_thinking(request)}"
          + (f" retry {attempt}" if attempt not in ("", "0") else "") + ("" if complete else " incomplete"),
          flush=True)


async def _answered(response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
    """Called when the headers are in: remember when, and log the call once the body has been read."""
    response.request.extensions["headers_at"] = time.monotonic()
    response.stream = _TimedBody(response)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers


def scenario_time(text: str) -> datetime:
    """The scenario date and time as an aware datetime; a bare date counts until its end (rule 21: "no later")."""
    if re.search(r"\d:\d\d", text):  # a bare ISO date would parse as midnight, the start of the day
        try:
            value = datetime.fromisoformat(text.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        except ValueError:

def _thinking(request: httpx2.Request) -> str:
    content = request.content or b""
    markers = (b'"enable_thinking": true', b'"enable_thinking":true',  # Qwen
               b'"type": "adaptive"', b'"type":"adaptive"')  # Anthropic
    if any(marker in content for marker in markers):
        return "on"
    openrouter = b'"reasoning": {"effort"' in content or b'"reasoning":{"effort"' in content
    excluded = b'"exclude": true' in content or b'"exclude":true' in content
    return "on" if openrouter and not excluded else "off"


async def _sent(request: httpx2.Request) -> None:
    """Note when a call left; a retry (the OpenAI client counts them in a header) is logged, with the timeout the
    attempt runs under, so a hanging model shows in the run logs before the worker times out."""
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()
    attempt = int(request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0") or 0)
    if attempt:
        print(f"[model] retry {attempt}/{retries()} thinking {_thinking(request)} "
              f"timeout {request.headers.get('x-stainless-read-timeout', '?')}s", flush=True)


class _TimedBody(httpx2.AsyncByteStream):
    """A response body that logs the call once it has fully arrived: the proxy sends the headers early and a
    thinking-on body can follow much later, so logging at the headers would hide the real duration."""

    def __init__(self, response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
        self._response = response
        self._stream = response.stream

    @property
    def elapsed(self):
        return getattr(self._stream, "elapsed", None)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        complete = False
        try:
            async for chunk in self._stream:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                complete = complete or b"data: [DONE]" in chunk  # a stream's reader may stop right there
                yield chunk
            complete = True
        finally:
            _log(self._response, complete)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.aclose()  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def _log(response: httpx2.Response, complete: bool) -> None:
    """One line per model call: status, seconds until the body was in (and until the headers came), request
    size, thinking mode, and which retry it was."""
    request = response.request
    now = time.monotonic()
    sent, headers = request.extensions.get("sent_at", now), request.extensions.get("headers_at", now)
    attempt = request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0")
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {now - sent:.1f}s (headers {headers - sent:.1f}s) "

"""Mail research alone: plan, batch (HTTP or tabs), resolve; prints seconds, records and resolved facts."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

import mail_batch  # noqa: E402
import mail_http  # noqa: E402
import research_mail as rm  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from briefing import read_brief  # noqa: E402
from orchestrator import scenario_time  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


async def main() -> None:
    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    trace = Trace()
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    briefing = await read_brief(task)
    access = {s["siteId"]: s for s in task["access"]}
    site = access[briefing.mail_site]
    print(f"brief {time.monotonic() - t0:.1f}s ref {briefing.tender_reference}", flush=True)
    t1 = time.monotonic()
    http_task = asyncio.create_task(mail_http.started(site, trace))
    sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in task["access"]}
    kinds = await rm.plan_searches(task["brief"], sites)
    kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == briefing.mail_site]
    print(f"plan {time.monotonic() - t1:.1f}s: {[(k.name, k.subject, k.sender) for k in kinds]}", flush=True)
    t2 = time.monotonic()
    out = await mail_batch.research_batch([], kinds, briefing.tender_reference, briefing.scenario_date,
                                          deadline=time.monotonic() + 400, brief=task["brief"], http=http_task)
    print(f"batch {time.monotonic() - t2:.1f}s fallback {out.reasons}", flush=True)
    http = http_task.result()
    mailbox = await rm.mailbox_address(http) if http else ""
    scenario = scenario_time(briefing.scenario_date)
    facts = rm.resolve_mail(list(out.results.values()), briefing.tender_reference,
                            mailbox.split("@", 1)[1] if "@" in mailbox else "", scenario, mailbox)
    print(f"total mail {time.monotonic() - t1:.1f}s", flush=True)
    print(facts.model_dump_json(exclude={"sources"}, indent=1))
    for s in facts.sources:
        print(" ", s.kind, s.used, s.sent_at.isoformat(), s.sender, "|", s.subject[:80])


asyncio.run(main())

"""
        Mail kinds that blank or omit fields come first; a kind only the verifier doubted (its doubts are mostly
        "the quote shows only the header") takes a mail tab only when one is spare: in one sandbox run eight
        doubted kinds held all four tabs and the one real gap (a setup pool) stayed open.
        """
        real = [g for g in todo if not (g.area == "mail" and g.reason.startswith(DOUBT))]
        doubted = [g for g in todo if g not in real]
        # doubts alone never start a round: in a complete run that round only delayed the answer (190 s)
        spare = max(0, len(getattr(self.o, "mail_sessions", None) or []) - sum(g.area == "mail" for g in real)) \
            if real else 0
        if doubted[spare:]:
            self.trace("gap_skipped", gaps=[g.ident for g in doubted[spare:]], reason="no spare mail tab")
        return real + doubted[:spare]

    async def reselect(self, rids: set[str]) -> None:
        """The final material choice again for the requirements a retry touched (no browsing)."""
        def told(kind, name: str):
            if not hints or name not in hints or not dataclasses.is_dataclass(kind):
                return kind
            return dataclasses.replace(kind, what=(
                f"{kind.what}. A first reading of this message left a gap ({hints[name][:200]}): report every "
                f"entry the message lists, with all keys, rates and validity windows, not only the first"))

        async def one(name: str, view: str) -> None:
            found = o.mail_results[name]
            record = await read_message(view, told(found.kind, name), o.reference)
            if record is not None:
                found.records = [*found.records, record]

        await asyncio.gather(*(one(name, view) for name in kinds for view in o.mail_results[name].kept),
                             return_exceptions=True)
        self.trace("mail_reread", kinds={name: len(o.mail_results[name].records) for name in kinds})

    async def resolve_mail(self) -> None:
        resolve = getattr(self.o, "_resolve_mail", None)
        if resolve is None or not getattr(self.o, "mail_sessions", None):
            return
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(resolve(), max(5.0, min(20.0, self.o.research_deadline - time.monotonic())))
        except Exception as error:
            self.o.board.problem("gaps", f"mail facts not resolved again: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")

    async def mails(self, kinds: list[str]) -> None:
        """The missing record kinds on fresh tabs, through the first pass's own mail loop (results add up, all
        kinds are resolved again); without a mail plan or tab, the whole mail research once more."""
        o = self.o
        o.mail_deadline = max(o.mail_deadline, self.until())
        if not o.mail_kinds or not o.mail_sessions:
            await o.mails(self._sites("mails")[0])
            return
        planned = {k.name for k in o.mail_kinds}
        missing = [k for k in kinds if k not in planned]
        if missing and hasattr(o, "plan_missing"):
            try:
                await o.plan_missing(missing)
            except Exception as error:
                o.board.problem("gaps", f"mail plan for {missing} failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")
        fresh = getattr(_module("research_mail"), "_fresh_tab", None)
        if fresh is not None:
            await asyncio.wait([asyncio.create_task(fresh(s)) for s in o.mail_sessions], timeout=FRESH_TAB_SECONDS)
        await o._research_mail([k for k in o.mail_kinds if k.name in kinds], deadline=self.until())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ merging (never loses a fact)

    def merge(self, research) -> None:
        """A retried requirement's ERP research replaces the earlier one only when it got further."""
        from research import ErpResearch

"""
The research over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): the same facts, readers, rules and calc as the browser path, with the
browsing done by http_nav.Navigator on http_site.HttpSite instead of step-by-step browser workers.

Per website a model navigates in a few large steps (it sees whole pages as text and asks for every page, search or
form it needs next at once) and names the pages that hold each kind of fact; the existing readers then extract the
facts from those pages (tender positions and Q&A, specification pages, ERP material views, messages), and the
orchestrator's verify / select / calc / gap logic runs unchanged on them (HttpOrchestrator subclasses it).

  brief -> plan (which website holds what) + mail plan (record kinds)
        -> tender: positions + Q&A          -> specification: current revision + requirements
        -> mails: record kinds              -> ERP: group searches -> material views
  readers -> board -> verify / select / calc -> answer for the bid form (browser, submit.py)

Nothing here names a site, a label, a path or a value of any dataset: the goals describe roles and facts.
"""

import re
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry

import calc
import llm
import research_mail

                      inspection_order,
                      same_revision)
from tracing import Trace

DETAIL_ROUNDS = 5  # navigator steps per material

TENDER_GOAL = """\
Tender {reference} (exactly this reference; similar references are other tenders). Open this tender, its
documents and its bidder questions and answers. Keep the document(s) that list the tender's positions (position
numbers, short texts, original quantities and units, requirement references), and every page of the bidder
Q&A (follow the list through all its pages). Documents can be opened by their title link; the tender may need
no further action to be read. Stay on this website: if it publishes no Q&A for the tender, another website does,
so keep none and finish once the positions are kept."""
