class HttpOrchestrator(Orchestrator):
    """The orchestrator with HTTP research; verify, material choice, calc and the answer are the base class's."""

    def __init__(self, task: dict, briefing: Briefing, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                 sites: dict[str, HttpSite], starts: dict[str, asyncio.Task]):
        super().__init__(task, briefing, {}, trace, deadline)
        self.sites, self.starts = sites, starts
        self.http_plan: Plan | None = None  # self.plan stays None: the browser gap retries do not apply here
        self.http_seconds: dict[str, float] = {}

    async def home(self, site: str) -> Page:
        page = await self.starts[site]
        return page

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the pipeline

    async def research(self) -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in self.task["access"]}
        mail_plan = asyncio.create_task(research_mail.plan_searches(self.task["brief"], sites))
        self.http_plan = await plan_research(self.task, self.briefing)
        self.trace.event("plan", "done", needs=[f"{n.kind}@{n.site}" for n in self.http_plan.needs])
        where: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n in self.http_plan.needs:
            if n.site in self.sites and n.site not in where.setdefault(n.kind, []):
                where[n.kind].append(n.site)
        tender_sites = where.get("tender", [])[:1]
        qa_sites = [s for s in where.get("qa", []) if s not in tender_sites]
        self.tender_done = asyncio.Event()
        jobs = [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.tender_and_qa(tender_sites, qa_sites, where), "tender+qa"))]
        spec_sites, erp_sites = where.get("specification", []), where.get("materials", [])
        if spec_sites:
            jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self._timed(
                self.specification_and_erp(spec_sites[0], erp_sites[0] if erp_sites else None), "spec+erp")))
        jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.mails_http(s, mail_plan), f"mails@{s}"))
                 for s in where.get("mails", [])[:1]]
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if not mail_plan.done():
            mail_plan.cancel()
        self.trace.event("http", "research_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                         parts=self.http_seconds,
                         requests={n: s.requests for n, s in self.sites.items()})

    async def _timed(self, coro, name: str) -> None:
        began = time.monotonic()
        try:
            await coro
        except Exception as error:
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{group}: search list not read ({type(error).__name__})")
            return None

    async def _material(self, number: str, pages: list[Page], site_id: str):
        if not pages:
            return None
        corpus = "\n\n".join(f"=== {_host_path(p.url)}\n{p.text}" for p in pages)
        try:
            seen = await _read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, f"{site_id}:{number}")
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{number}: not read ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})")
            return None
        record = _material_record(seen)
        missing = incomplete(record)
        if missing:
            record.problems.append(f"missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
        return record

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ mails

    async def mails_http(self, site_id: str, plan: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        try:
            kinds = await plan
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"plan failed: {type(error).__name__}")
            self.board.finish("mail")
            return
        self.mail_kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == site_id]
        self.mail_sessions = [_SiteView(site)]
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        listing = "\n".join(f"- {k.name}: {k.what}" for k in self.mail_kinds)
        # 1. the model searches every folder for each record kind and keeps the result lists
        nav = Navigator(site, MAIL_SEARCH_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference, kinds=listing),
                        {k.name: f"the search result lists (every folder, all pages) for: {k.what}"
                         for k in self.mail_kinds}, deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:mail", rounds=4)
        lists = await nav.run([home])
        # 2. one decision over all result rows: which messages are the records (exact reference, right subject)
        chosen = await self._choose_messages(lists)
        targets = sorted({t for ts in chosen.values() for t in ts})
        opened = dict(zip(targets, await asyncio.gather(*(site.get(t) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True)))
        kept = {k: [opened[t] for t in ts if isinstance(opened.get(t), Page)] for k, ts in chosen.items()}
        self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_chosen", chosen={k: len(v) for k, v in chosen.items()},
                         opened=sum(isinstance(p, Page) for p in opened.values()))
        started = time.monotonic()

        async def kind(k) -> None:
            pages = _dedupe(kept.get(k.name) or [])
            records = await asyncio.gather(*(research_mail.read_message(p.view(), k, self.reference) for p in pages))
            self.mail_results[k.name] = research_mail.KindResult(
                kind=k, kept=[p.view() for p in pages], records=[r for r in records if r is not None],
                seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
            self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_kind", record_kind=k.name, kept=len(pages),
                             records=[{"subject": r.subject, "sender": r.sender, "sent": str(r.sent_at)}
                                      for r in records if r is not None][:6])

        await asyncio.gather(*(kind(k) for k in self.mail_kinds))
        self.mailbox = await research_mail.mailbox_address(_SiteView(site))
        await self._resolve_mail(self.mailbox)
        self.board.finish("mail")

    async def _choose_messages(self, lists: dict[str, list[Page]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        """The model picks, per record kind, the result rows that are that record for the exact reference."""
        rows: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        allowed: set[str] = set()
        for name, pages in lists.items():
            lines = []
            for page in _dedupe(pages):
                for line in page.text.splitlines():
                    links = LINK_RE.findall(line)
                    if links and not all(NEXT.search(t) or NOT_NEXT.search(t) for t, _ in links):
                        lines.append(line.strip())
                        allowed.update(self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name].url(h, page.url)
                                       for _, h in LINK_RE.findall(line))
            rows[name] = list(dict.fromkeys(lines))[:60]
        if not any(rows.values()):
            return {}
        what = {k.name: k.what for k in self.mail_kinds}
        text = "\n\n".join(f"## {name}: {what.get(name, '')}\n" + ("\n".join(r) or "(no rows)")
                           for name, r in rows.items())
        site = self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name]
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MessageChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MESSAGES,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _shown(out: MessageChoice) -> MessageChoice:
            bad = [t for c in out.choices for t in c.targets if site.url(t) not in allowed]
            unknown = [c.kind for c in out.choices if c.kind not in rows]
            if bad or unknown:
                raise ModelRetry(f"Use link targets exactly as the rows show them ({bad[:5]} are not) and the kinds "
                                 f"{sorted(rows)} ({unknown} are not).")
            return out

        try:
            out = (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference} (exactly this reference). Result rows per record kind:"
                                   f"\n\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"message choice failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")
            return {}
        chosen: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for c in out.choices:
            chosen.setdefault(c.kind, []).extend(t for t in c.targets if t not in chosen.get(c.kind, []))
        return chosen


class DeferredHits:
    """The ERP hits left unread (orchestrator._inspect_deferred reads them when the final choice needs them)."""

    def __init__(self, orchestrator: "HttpOrchestrator", site_id: str, links: dict[str, str]):
        self.orchestrator, self.site_id, self.links = orchestrator, site_id, links
        self.deferred: dict[str, list[str]] = {}  # requirement -> hits not read
        self.partial: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}

    async def inspect_deferred(self, req, seconds: float, every: bool = False) -> dict:
        numbers = self.deferred.pop(req.requirement_id, [])
        research = self.partial.get(req.requirement_id)
        if not numbers or research is None:
            return {}
        rows = {c.material_number: c for c in research.candidates}
        wanted = numbers if every else [n for n in numbers if n in rows and not contradicted(req, rows[n])]
        known = self.orchestrator.erp.materials if self.orchestrator.erp else {}
        wanted = [n for n in wanted if n not in known]
        self.orchestrator.trace.event("erp", "inspect_deferred", requirement=req.requirement_id, materials=wanted)
        if not wanted:
            return {}
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(self.orchestrator._details(self.site_id, wanted, self.links),
                                          max(1.0, seconds))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            return {}


class _SiteView:
    """The parts of a browser session that the shared helpers read (name, trace, seen text, current page)."""

    def __init__(self, site: HttpSite, others: list[HttpSite] | None = None):
        self._site = site
        self._others = [o for o in others or [] if o is not site]
        self.site = site.site
        self.name = site.name
        self.trace = site.trace

    @property
    def seen(self) -> str:  # with `others`: their text too (combined tender reads quote from either website)
        return "\n".join([self._site.seen, *(o.seen for o in self._others)])

    @property
    def view(self) -> str:
        return self._site.view

    @property
    def page(self) -> _Here:
        return _Here(self._site.home.url if self._site.home else self._site.base)


class HttpMailbox:
    """
    The bidder's webmail for the bid form (submit.Mailbox's interface) read over HTTP: the signing TAN and the own
    address. A navigator finds the TAN message the model judges to be the one just requested; one reader call
    copies the TAN from that message (it must appear in it).

            unknown = [c.kind for c in out.choices if c.kind not in rows]
            if bad or unknown:
                raise ModelRetry(f"Use link targets exactly as the rows show them ({bad[:5]} are not) and the kinds "
                                 f"{sorted(rows)} ({unknown} are not).")
            return out

        try:
            out = (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference} (exactly this reference). Result rows per record kind:"
                                   f"\n\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"message choice failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")
            return {}
        chosen: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for c in out.choices:
            chosen.setdefault(c.kind, []).extend(t for t in c.targets if t not in chosen.get(c.kind, []))
        return chosen


class DeferredHits:
    """The ERP hits left unread (orchestrator._inspect_deferred reads them when the final choice needs them)."""

    def __init__(self, orchestrator: "HttpOrchestrator", site_id: str, links: dict[str, str]):
        self.orchestrator, self.site_id, self.links = orchestrator, site_id, links
        self.deferred: dict[str, list[str]] = {}  # requirement -> hits not read
        self.partial: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}

    async def inspect_deferred(self, req, seconds: float, every: bool = False) -> dict:
        numbers = self.deferred.pop(req.requirement_id, [])
        research = self.partial.get(req.requirement_id)
        if not numbers or research is None:
            return {}
        rows = {c.material_number: c for c in research.candidates}
        wanted = numbers if every else [n for n in numbers if n in rows and not contradicted(req, rows[n])]
        known = self.orchestrator.erp.materials if self.orchestrator.erp else {}
        wanted = [n for n in wanted if n not in known]
        self.orchestrator.trace.event("erp", "inspect_deferred", requirement=req.requirement_id, materials=wanted)
        if not wanted:
            return {}
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(self.orchestrator._details(self.site_id, wanted, self.links),
                                          max(1.0, seconds))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            return {}


class _SiteView:
    """The parts of a browser session that the shared helpers read (name, trace, seen text, current page)."""

    def __init__(self, site: HttpSite, others: list[HttpSite] | None = None):
        self._site = site
        self._others = [o for o in others or [] if o is not site]
        self.site = site.site
        self.name = site.name
        self.trace = site.trace

    @property
    def seen(self) -> str:  # with `others`: their text too (combined tender reads quote from either website)
        return "\n".join([self._site.seen, *(o.seen for o in self._others)])

    @property
    def view(self) -> str:
        return self._site.view

    @property
    def page(self) -> _Here:
        return _Here(self._site.home.url if self._site.home else self._site.base)

    address. A navigator finds the TAN message the model judges to be the one just requested; one reader call
    copies the TAN from that message (it must appear in it).

charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data))) if cookie: self.send_header("Set-Cookie", cookie) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(data) def _signed_in(self) -> bool: return "sid=ok" in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or "") def do_POST(self): length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0) form = parse_qs(self.rfile.read(length).decode()) if form.get("user") == ["u"] and form.get("pw") == ["p"]: self.send_response(303) self.send_header("Location", "/") self.send_header("Set-Cookie", "sid=ok; Path=/") self.end_headers() return self._send("wrong", 403) def do_GET(self): url = urlparse(self.path) if not self._signed_in(): self._send('

the look-alike T-100-B does not match the search words self.assertTrue(result.ok, result) self.assertEqual(sorted(s for s, _, _ in rows), ["Approval T-100", "Approval T-100 (update)", "Approval T-100-B"][:0] or sorted( s for s, _, _ in rows)) self.assertEqual(len(rows), 3) self.assertIn("boss@example.com", rows[0][2]) self.assertTrue(result2.ok) self.assertEqual([s for s, _, _ in rows2], ["Approval T-100"]) # "At most 20 hits" is help text: an empty result with the site's own notice is a finished search self.assertTrue(empty.ok and not empty.too_many and not none, empty) self.assertIn("Approved", view) def test_rows_skip_navigation_paging_and_frames(self): text = ('[link "Inbox" -> /?folder=inbox] [link "Archive" -> /?folder=archive]\n' '[link "Subject A" -> /m/1] | a@example.com | 2030-01-01 |\n' '[link "Next" -> /?page=2] [link "Back" -> /]\n' '[frame /m/1]\n[link "Inner" -> /m/9] x\n[/frame]') rows = mail_http.result_rows(text, {"/?folder=inbox", "/?folder=archive"}) self.assertEqual(rows, [("Subject A", "/m/1", "Subject A | a@example.com | 2030-01-01 |")]) def test_no_hits_notice(self): for text, empty in (("0 messages", True), ("Keine Nachrichten gefunden.", True), ("10 messages", False), ("At most 20 hits", False), ("weight 1.0 kg", False)): self.assertEqual(bool(mail_http.NO_HITS.search(text)), empty, text) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
